answer: Make every new agent name earn its slot with a verifiable delay function seeded by that epoch's public randomness beacon, so nobody can precompute it. The puzzle takes about a day of strictly sequential hashing; parallel hardware does not help, yet checking it costs a walnut-sized sliver of a second. One honest agent pays once, like drafting a single sonnet slowly, but a farm of a thousand fakes must burn a thousand machine-days, renewed every month.
